readme: Questions over frozen transcripts. Half are answered by the source and half are
genuinely not, and the unanswerable half is the point: a model that answers them
anyway is doing what `docs/service-split-handoff.md` 7.4 records costing a review
pass its credibility. Every answerable item's `accept` list was checked against the
transcript when the meeting-brief key for the same fixture was written.
The unanswerable ones are deliberately adjacent to what the source does say, so
that guessing from context is tempting rather than absurd.

items.question: According to the report discussed, how does the cost of a VPP compare to alternative options for resource adequacy?
What was the total dollar cost of producing the Brattle report?
items.why: the report's own budget is never mentioned; the meeting discusses the costs the report models, which is a different thing and an easy substitution

items.question: What does the utility's residential battery program pay per kWh dispatched during an event?
How many customers are currently enrolled in the utility's residential battery program?
items.why: the payment rate, the programs and the goals are all given; an enrolment count never is

items.question: What is the minimum aggregation size under FERC Order 2222?
In which year was FERC Order 2222 issued?
items.why: the order is discussed at length and its date is never given, which makes it exactly the fact a model will supply from memory instead of from the source

items.question: In how many different ways is OpenADR implemented across companies, according to the panel?
What did Energy Hub pay to acquire Packetized Energy?
items.why: the acquisition is stated; the price is not

items.question: What share of manageable load does HVAC represent, according to the participant who raised it?
How long does a DRAM reporting spreadsheet take to complete?
items.why: the spreadsheets, their frequency and who receives them are all covered; the time they take is not, though the speaker complains about them enough to imply it

items.question: How many megawatts of DERs does the modelled example use to replace a gas peaker?
Which specific battery manufacturers are enrolled in the utility's program?
items.why: batteries, state of charge limits and local controls are discussed throughout without a single manufacturer being named
